name: @gramstax/worker-thread
description: Worker thread lifecycle with type-safe RPC, inter-worker socket gateway, and worker pools. Multi-runtime (Bun, Node.js).

scripts.build:docs: bun run build --dts-only --no-minify --tsconfig tsconfig.build.docs.json && api-extractor run --local --verbose && api-documenter markdown -i ./docs/extractor/temp -o ./docs/markdown && api-documenter yaml -i ./docs/extractor/temp -o ./docs/yaml
scripts.bench: bun run ./bench/rpc-roundtrip.bench.ts && bun run ./bench/gateway-roundtrip.bench.ts && bun run ./bench/payload-codec.bench.ts && bun run ./bench/pool-scale.bench.ts && bun run ./bench/reconnect-storm.bench.ts

author: gramstax
